t: Faithfull 20Ltr carbon steel jerry can provides a robust and reliable solution for fuel storage and transport. The heavy-duty construction is ideal for demanding trade environments, such as construction sites or workshops. The can features internal and external fuel-retardant epoxy powder coating, ensuring a long-lasting, durable finish and excellent corrosion protection. A secure locking pin mechanism on the cap prevents accidental opening, while the integrated triple handle allows for safe and easy 2-man transportation. Includes a gasket seal to further enhance security by preventing leaks and fuel evaporation.
b: Integrated Triple Handle For Easy Carriage
Gasket Sealed To Prevent Leaks & Evaporation
